test_cases.summary:
Verify Edit access in active workflow level
when the image belongs to the user's current workflow / approval level
test_cases.description:
Feature: Workflow-Based Edit Access Control
The system restricts editing by workflow level.

Scenario: Edit access in active workflow level

Given the image belongs to the user’s current workflow / approval level
When the user selects the image
Then all editing actions should be enabled
test_cases.acceptance:
All editing actions should be enabled
The behavior should be validated when the user selects the image.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Access image in non-active level
when the image is in a completed or other approval level
test_cases.description:
Feature: Read-Only Image Access
The system enforces read-only mode for inactive workflow images.

Scenario: Access image in non-active level

Given the image is in a completed or other approval level
When the user opens the image
Then the image should be view-only and non-editable
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should be view-only and non-editable
The behavior should be validated when the user opens the image.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display Send Selected to QC button
when a PENDING image is selected in the image grid
test_cases.description:
Feature: Data Labeling – Send to QC Action Availability
As an Assignee, the user wants to send images to QC so that review can begin.

Scenario: Display Send Selected to QC button
Given a PENDING image is selected in the image grid
When the image is displayed in the right-side panel
Then the Send Selected to QC button should be visible and enabled
test_cases.acceptance:
The Send Selected to QC button should be visible and enabled
The behavior should be validated when the image is displayed in the right-side panel.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Send image to QC workflow
when a PENDING image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Data Labeling – Send Image to QC
As an Assignee, the user wants to send selected images to QC so that the approval workflow can start.

Scenario: Send image to QC workflow
Given a PENDING image is selected
When the user clicks the Send Selected to QC button
Then the image should be sent to the QC workflow
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should be sent to the QC workflow
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Send Selected to QC button.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Assign image to Approval Level 1 user
when the image is sent to QC
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Routing – Image Assignment
As a QC workflow system, the image must be routed to the correct approval level so that review can begin.

Scenario: Assign image to Approval Level 1 user
Given the image is sent to QC
When the QC assignment is processed
Then the image should be assigned to the Approval Level 1 user
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should be assigned to the Approval Level 1 user
The behavior should be validated when the QC assignment is processed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Change image status from PENDING to IN_REVIEW
when the image is sent to QC
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Workflow – Status Transition
As a system, the image status must update correctly when entering QC.

Scenario: Change image status from PENDING to IN_REVIEW
Given the image is sent to QC
When the image status is checked
Then the status should change from PENDING to IN_REVIEW
test_cases.acceptance:
The status should change from PENDING to IN_REVIEW
The behavior should be validated when the image status is checked.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display review level indicator inside image
when the image is in QC review state
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Review – Visual Indicators
As a reviewer, the user wants to see the review level clearly on the image so that the current stage is obvious.

Scenario: Display review level indicator inside image
Given the image is in QC review state
When the image is displayed in the image grid
Then the review level indicator should be displayed inside the image
test_cases.acceptance:
The review level indicator should be displayed inside the image
The behavior should be validated when the image is displayed in the image grid.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display "IN_REVIEW L2" label inside image
when the image has moved to the QC workflow
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Review – Level Label Display
As a reviewer, the user wants the exact QC level to be visible on the image.

Scenario: Display “IN_REVIEW L2” label inside image
Given the image has moved to the QC workflow
When the image is displayed in the grid
Then IN_REVIEW L2 should be displayed inside the image
test_cases.acceptance:
IN_REVIEW L2 should be displayed inside the image
The behavior should be validated when the image is displayed in the grid.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Remove image from PENDING list after sending to QC
when the image is sent to QC
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Workflow – Status Filtering
As a user, the user should no longer see QC images under PENDING status.

Scenario: Remove image from PENDING list after sending to QC
Given the image is sent to QC
When the user filters images by PENDING status
Then the image should not be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should not be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user filters images by PENDING status.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display image under IN_REVIEW status
when the image is sent to QC
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Workflow – IN_REVIEW Listing
As a reviewer, the user wants QC images to appear under IN_REVIEW status.

Scenario: Display image under IN_REVIEW status
Given the image is sent to QC
When the user filters images by IN_REVIEW status
Then the image should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user filters images by IN_REVIEW status.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display QUALITY CHECKER stage for Levels
when the Approval Levels user is on the Data Labeling page
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Session – Stage Display
As an Approval Level reviewer, the user wants to clearly identify the current session stage.

Scenario: Display QUALITY CHECKER stage for Levels
Given the Approval Levels user is on the Data Labeling page
When the session details are viewed
Then the Stage should be displayed as QUALITY CHECKER
test_cases.acceptance:
The Stage should be displayed as QUALITY CHECKER
The behavior should be validated when the session details are viewed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display Assignee name for Approval Levels
when the Approval Levels user is on the Data Labeling page
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Session – Assignee Display
As a reviewer, the user wants to see the correct assignee information.

Scenario: Display Assignee name for Approval Levels
Given the Approval Levels user is on the Data Labeling page
When the session details are viewed
Then the Assignee should be displayed correctly
test_cases.acceptance:
The Assignee should be displayed correctly
The behavior should be validated when the session details are viewed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display Approval Level as Level 1 , Level 2 ,  Level 3, Level 4 and  Level 5
when the Approval Levels user is on the Data Labeling page
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Session – Approval Level Display
As a reviewer, the user wants to confirm their approval levels.

Scenario: Display Approval Level as Level 1 , Level 2 ,  Level 3, Level 4 and  Level 5
Given the Approval Levels user is on the Data Labeling page
When the session details are viewed
Then the Approval Level should be displayed as Level 1 , Level 2 ,  Level 3, Level 4 and  Level 5
test_cases.acceptance:
The Approval Level should be displayed as Level 1 , Level 2 ,  Level 3, Level 4 and  Level 5
The behavior should be validated when the session details are viewed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Default Select Status is IN_REVIEW
when the user is logged in as Approval Levels
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Status Filtering – Default State
As an Approval Levels reviewer, the user wants to immediately see images pending their review.

Scenario: Default Select Status is IN_REVIEW
Given the user is logged in as Approval Levels
When the user opens the Data Labeling page
Then the Select Status field should default to IN_REVIEW
test_cases.acceptance:
The Select Status field should default to IN_REVIEW
The behavior should be validated when the user opens the Data Labeling page.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Auto-check Awaiting Approval for Levels
when the user is logged in as Approval Level
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Filter Defaults – Awaiting Approval
As a reviewer, the user wants the system to automatically filter images awaiting their action.

Scenario: Auto-check Awaiting Approval for Levels
Given the user is logged in as Approval Level
When the Data Labeling page is loaded
Then Awaiting Approval should be auto-checked
test_cases.acceptance:
Awaiting Approval should be auto-checked
The behavior should be validated when the Data Labeling page is loaded.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Display Accept and Reject actions
when an image is in IN_REVIEW  state
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Actions – Availability
As a Levels reviewer, the user wants to accept or reject images.

Scenario: Display Accept and Reject actions
Given an image is in IN_REVIEW  state
When the image actions are viewed
Then Accept and Reject options should be available
test_cases.acceptance:
Accept and Reject options should be available
The behavior should be validated when the image actions are viewed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Any Level user accepts image
when an image is in IN_REVIEW  state
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Actions – Accept at Levels
As a Levels reviewer, the user wants to approve images.

Scenario: Any Level user accepts image
Given an image is in IN_REVIEW  state
When any Level user clicks Accept
Then the image should be accepted at Levels
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should be accepted at Levels
The behavior should be validated when any Level user clicks Accept.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Reject moves image to earlier approval level
when a rejected image is selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: QC Rollback Workflow – Reject Action
As a previous level reviewer, the user wants to further reject the image.

Scenario: Reject moves image to earlier approval level
Given a rejected image is selected
When the user clicks Reject
Then the image should move to the earlier approval level
test_cases.acceptance:
The image should move to the earlier approval level
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Reject.
